prompt: Complete the short HTML document doctype with its required name.
explanation: The short doctype identifies HTML and helps browsers use standards mode.

prompt: Name the root element of this HTML document.
explanation: The html element is the root of an HTML document.

prompt: Name the container for document metadata before the body.
explanation: The head element groups document metadata such as the title and linked stylesheets.

prompt: Name the element that provides the document title.
explanation: The title element supplies the document title, commonly shown in the browser tab.

prompt: Supply the attribute that declares UTF-8 encoding on meta.
explanation: The charset attribute on meta declares the document character encoding.

prompt: Supply the rel value that loads this CSS file as a stylesheet.
explanation: A link with rel="stylesheet" references an external stylesheet.

prompt: Name the element used to embed CSS in the document head.
explanation: The style element contains an embedded stylesheet.

prompt: Name the element that contains the HTML document body.
explanation: The body element represents the document content.

prompt: Use the highest-level heading element for this main page heading.
explanation: h1 is the highest heading rank; use heading ranks to express content hierarchy.

prompt: Name the element for a section whose purpose is major navigation links.
explanation: The nav element represents a section containing major navigation links.

prompt: Name the element for this self-contained article.
code:
<____>

A day learning CSS

Today I built a card.
explanation: An article is a self-contained composition that can be reused or distributed independently.

prompt: Name the element for the dominant content of this document body.
explanation: main identifies the dominant content, excluding repeated site navigation or other recurring content.

prompt: Name the element for this paragraph.
code: <____>Practice turns small ideas into useful skills.
explanation: The p element represents a paragraph.

prompt: Name the unordered list element.
explanation: ul groups list items when their order is not significant.

prompt: Name the ordered list element for these sequential steps.
explanation: ol represents a list whose item order is significant.

prompt: Name the list-item element inside this unordered list.
explanation: Each li represents an item in its parent list.

prompt: Name the element that preserves spaces and line breaks in its content.
explanation: pre represents preformatted text whose structure is expressed through typographic conventions.

prompt: Name the caption element inside this figure.
explanation: figcaption provides a caption or legend for its parent figure.

prompt: Supply the attribute that gives this anchor a destination URL.
explanation: An a element with href creates a hyperlink to the supplied URL.

prompt: Supply the image attribute for a text alternative.
explanation: alt provides replacement text appropriate to the image’s purpose when an image cannot be perceived.

prompt: Supply the image attribute for its resource URL.
explanation: src specifies the image resource used by the img element.

prompt: Name the element that expresses stress emphasis.
explanation: em expresses stress emphasis, which can affect how a sentence is understood.

prompt: Name the element that marks strong importance.
explanation: strong marks content with strong importance, seriousness, or urgency.

prompt: Name the element for a fragment of computer code.
explanation: code represents a fragment of computer code.

prompt: Supply the machine-readable date attribute on time.
explanation: datetime gives the time element a machine-readable date, time, or duration.

prompt: Name the element that creates a line break in this address.
explanation: br represents a line break; paragraphs should still use paragraph elements.

prompt: Name the element for this HTML table.
explanation: table represents data arranged in rows and columns.

prompt: Name the element that labels this table with a caption.
explanation: caption provides the table’s title or explanatory caption.

prompt: Name the element that represents a row of table cells.
explanation: tr groups cells into a table row.

prompt: Name the header-cell element in this table row.
explanation: th represents a table header cell, while td represents a data cell.

prompt: Supply the scope keyword for a header that labels its column.
explanation: scope="col" associates the header cell with cells in its column.

prompt: Supply the label attribute that explicitly associates it with this input ID.
explanation: A label’s for value identifies the associated labelable control by its ID.

prompt: Choose the input type specifically for an email address.
explanation: The email input state accepts email address input and provides email-specific validation.

prompt: Choose the input type for a password entry whose characters are obscured.
explanation: The password input state obscures the entered text visually; it does not itself encrypt transmission.

prompt: Choose the input type for an independently checkable option.
explanation: Checkbox controls independently represent checked or unchecked states.

prompt: Choose the input type for mutually exclusive choices sharing a name.
explanation: Radio buttons with the same name form a group in which only one can be checked.

prompt: Supply the boolean attribute that makes this input require a value.
explanation: required participates in constraint validation; server-side validation remains necessary.

prompt: Supply the attribute that names this input in submitted form data.
explanation: name supplies the form-data key for a successful named control.

prompt: Supply the button type that submits its associated form.
explanation: A submit button can submit its associated form when activated.

prompt: Supply the button type that has no default form-submission action.
explanation: type="button" avoids the button’s default form-submission behavior.

prompt: Name the element for a multiline plain-text editing control.
explanation: textarea is a multiline plain-text editing control.

prompt: Name the element for this group of related form controls.
explanation: fieldset groups related form controls and can be labeled by a legend.

prompt: Name the element that captions this fieldset.
explanation: The first legend child supplies the caption for its fieldset.

prompt: Name the element for an expandable disclosure widget.
code:
<____>Read a hint

A class selector starts with a dot.
explanation: details provides a disclosure widget whose summary is the visible label.

prompt: Name the summary element that labels this disclosure widget.
explanation: summary provides the caption or legend for its parent details element.

prompt: Complete the type selector to target all paragraph elements.
explanation: A type selector matches elements by their element type name.

prompt: Supply the punctuation that starts the card class selector.
explanation: A period before a class name forms a class selector.

prompt: Supply the punctuation that starts the lesson ID selector.
explanation: A number sign before an ID value forms an ID selector.

prompt: Complete the pseudo-class that applies while the pointer designates a link.
explanation: The :hover pseudo-class matches an element designated by a pointing device.

prompt: Complete the pseudo-class that matches a focused input.
explanation: The :focus pseudo-class matches an element that has input focus.

prompt: Complete the pseudo-element for content inserted before the element’s content.
explanation: ::before generates a pseudo-element before the originating element’s content.

prompt: Name the property that sets the foreground text color.
explanation: color sets the foreground color and provides the currentColor value.

prompt: Name the longhand property that sets only the background color.
explanation: background-color paints the background color behind any background images.

prompt: Name the shorthand property for space on all four sides inside the border.
explanation: padding sets the inner spacing between content and the border.

prompt: Name the shorthand property for space outside all four borders.
explanation: margin sets spacing outside a box’s border edges.

prompt: Supply the border-style keyword for an unbroken single line.
explanation: The solid border style draws an unbroken line.

prompt: Name the shorthand property that rounds the box’s corners.
explanation: border-radius sets the radii used to round border corners.

prompt: Name the property that sets the horizontal size in this writing mode.
explanation: width specifies a box’s width subject to its sizing model and layout rules.

prompt: Name the property that prevents this box’s width from exceeding 100%.
explanation: max-width imposes an upper limit on the used width.

prompt: Supply the box-sizing keyword that includes padding and border in the specified width.
explanation: border-box measures a specified size to the border edge, including padding and border.

prompt: Supply the display keyword that creates a block-level flex container.
explanation: display: flex establishes a flex formatting context for the container’s children.

prompt: Supply the flex-direction keyword that makes the main axis follow the block axis.
explanation: column sets the flex main axis to the container’s block axis.

prompt: Supply the flex-wrap keyword that permits items to occupy multiple lines.
explanation: wrap allows flex items to wrap onto multiple flex lines.

prompt: Supply the justify-content keyword that distributes leftover space between items only.
explanation: space-between places the first and last items at the edges and distributes space between items.

prompt: Supply the align-items keyword that centers flex items on the cross axis.
explanation: For a flex container, align-items: center centers each item in its cross-axis alignment area.

prompt: Name the longhand property that gives this item a flex grow factor of 1.
explanation: flex-grow controls the share of positive free space assigned to a flex item.

prompt: Name the longhand property that gives this item a flex shrink factor of 0.
explanation: flex-shrink controls the factor used when distributing negative free space.

prompt: Name the longhand property that gives this item an initial main size of 200px.
explanation: flex-basis specifies the initial main size used in flex layout before free-space distribution.

prompt: Supply the display keyword that creates a block-level grid container.
explanation: display: grid establishes a grid formatting context.

prompt: Name the property that defines the explicit grid’s column tracks.
explanation: grid-template-columns defines the explicit column tracks and optional line names.

prompt: Supply the function name that repeats three equal fractional columns.
explanation: repeat() repeats a track-list fragment a specified number of times.

prompt: Supply the fractional unit for three equal shares of available grid space.
explanation: The fr unit represents a fraction of leftover space in a grid container.

prompt: Name the shorthand property for gaps between grid rows and columns.
explanation: gap sets the row-gap and column-gap gutters.

prompt: Supply the grid-line placement keyword that spans this item across two columns.
explanation: span followed by an integer specifies the number of grid tracks to span.

prompt: Name the property that gives text a 32px font size.
explanation: font-size sets the size of the font used to render text.

prompt: Name the property that chooses a prioritized font-family list.
explanation: font-family supplies an ordered list of font families and generic families.

prompt: Name the property that gives this heading a weight of 700.
explanation: font-weight selects the font’s weight, subject to the available font faces.

prompt: Name the property that sets a unitless line-height of 1.6.
explanation: A unitless line-height is multiplied by the element’s font size to calculate line box height.

prompt: Name the property that centers inline text within the block.
explanation: text-align controls the inline alignment of content within a block container.

prompt: Name the property that sets spacing between letters.
explanation: letter-spacing adjusts spacing between typographic character units.

prompt: Supply the white-space keyword that preserves whitespace and line breaks without wrapping.
explanation: white-space: pre preserves spaces and segment breaks and prevents soft wrapping.

prompt: Supply the position keyword that keeps the box in flow while allowing offsets.
explanation: Relative positioning offsets a box visually while preserving its normal-flow space.

prompt: Supply the position keyword that removes the box from flow and positions it relative to its containing block.
explanation: Absolutely positioned boxes are removed from normal flow and use their containing block for placement.

prompt: Supply the overflow keyword that clips overflow and provides a scrolling mechanism when needed.
explanation: overflow: auto provides scrolling when content overflows its scrollable area.

prompt: Name the property that sets this box’s opacity to one half.
explanation: opacity applies transparency to the element’s rendered output, including its descendants.

prompt: Supply the pointer keyword for a cursor that commonly indicates a link.
explanation: The pointer cursor is commonly used to indicate a link.

prompt: Name the property that adds a visible outline without taking up layout space.
explanation: An outline is drawn around an element without consuming box-model layout space.

prompt: Supply the function that reads this custom property.
explanation: var() substitutes the value of a custom property into another declaration.

prompt: Supply the required prefix of two hyphens for this custom property name.
explanation: Custom property names start with two hyphens and are case-sensitive.

prompt: Supply the function that calculates a length from mixed compatible inputs.
explanation: calc() performs arithmetic on CSS numeric values, subject to type compatibility rules.

prompt: Supply the function that constrains this font size between 1rem and 2rem.
explanation: clamp() selects a preferred value constrained by a minimum and maximum.

prompt: Supply the root-relative font unit for this 2-unit margin.
explanation: rem lengths are relative to the root element’s font size.

prompt: Complete the at-rule that applies styles only when the media query matches.
explanation: @media makes enclosed style rules conditional on a media query.

prompt: Complete the at-rule that tests whether a declaration is supported.
explanation: @supports conditionally applies rules based on support for CSS features.

prompt: Supply the transform function that rotates an element by 10 degrees.
explanation: rotate() applies a two-dimensional rotation about the transform origin.

prompt: Supply the transform function that moves an element 12px on the x-axis.
explanation: translateX() applies a translation along the x-axis.

prompt: Name the longhand property that makes a transition last 200ms.
explanation: transition-duration sets how long a transition animation takes.

prompt: Complete the at-rule that defines the named animation’s intermediate styles.
explanation: @keyframes defines the keyframes used by a named CSS animation.

prompt: Name the longhand property that selects the animation named fade.
explanation: animation-name selects the keyframe animation to apply to an element.

prompt: Supply the CSS-wide keyword that explicitly uses the parent element’s computed value.
explanation: inherit explicitly uses the property’s computed value from the parent element.
